AD/CVD investigations are key trade remedies that can be leveraged by U.S. manufacturers for relief. Manufacturers can petition the International Trade Commission (ITC) and the Department of Commerce (DOC) to initiate investigations when imports are dumped or subsidized and injure domestic industry.
